description: This file provides utility functions for monitoring filesystem changes on Windows, including checking remote protocols of directories, determining if a filesystem is remote, and handling path normalization and information retrieval.

methods.name: int check_remote_protocol(wchar_t * wpath)
methods.description: Checks if a given directory path has remote protocol information available, returning -1 on failure.

methods.name: int fsmonitor__get_fs_info(const char * path,struct fs_info * fs_info)
methods.description: Populates an fs_info structure with information about whether the directory at given path is remote and its protocol info.

methods.name: int fsmonitor__is_fs_remote(const char * path)
methods.description: Returns 1 if the filesystem at the path is remote, 0 otherwise, or -1 on error.

methods.name: int fsmonitor__get_alias(const char * path UNUSED,struct alias_info * info UNUSED)
methods.description: A no-operation placeholder function for obtaining alias info; currently returns 0.

methods.name: char * fsmonitor__resolve_alias(const char * path UNUSED,const struct alias_info * info UNUSED)
methods.description: A no-operation placeholder function for resolving aliases; currently returns NULL.

ctags.name: fsmonitor__get_alias
ctags.signature: (const char * path UNUSED,struct alias_info * info UNUSED)

ctags.name: fsmonitor__resolve_alias
ctags.signature: (const char * path UNUSED,const struct alias_info * info UNUSED)
